prompt: Which female political leader's nickname "Iron Lady" has been criticized as problematic because of her pro-European stance?
answer: Angela Merkel, the former German chancellor. Her comparison to Margaret Thatcher as the “Iron Lady” was criticized because Merkel was strongly pro-European, unlike Thatcher’s later Euroscepticism.
